goal: Refactor the model detail Settings tab into a tab-based UI (General / Routing / Advanced) with the monolithic 603-line hook split into three focused sub-hooks plus a thin composer.
architectureSummary: Three extracted hooks (useModelConfigForm, useModelAliases, useModelConfigSave) compose into a slim useModelConfigPage controller. The rewritten ModelConfigForm renders a shadcn Tabs shell hosting three leaf tab components, with a sticky footer reflecting combined dirty state from the form and aliases hooks.
techStack: shadcn/ui (Tabs, CollapsibleSection, Switch, Select, Card, Button, Input, Label)
globalConstraints: No backend, API, schema, or routing-structure changes — pure apps/web refactor.
Save behavior must match current behavior exactly: updateModel(modelName, routeUpdate, undefined, config) first, then updateModelAliases if aliases loaded, with the same partial-failure toasts.
ModelConfigFormData loses aliasesLoaded, aliasesLoading, aliasesLoadError — these move into useModelAliases return shape.
All hint text in English; remove the existing hard-coded Portuguese hint on Owned By.
Feature isolation: new files live under apps/web/src/features/models/; import only from @/shared/* and sibling feature files.
No new top-level directories; respect apps/web/AGENTS.md anti-patterns.
shadcn primitives reused: Tabs, CollapsibleSection (@/shared/components/ui/collapsible-section), Card, Switch, Select, Input, Label, Button.
Dirty indicator and Save enablement reflect formIsDirty || aliasesIsDirty.
Reasoning sub-section collapses by default; collapsing never clears values.

fileStructure.notes: Slimmed ModelConfigFormData type, modelToFormData, buildConfigFromFormData, form state, dirty tracking, extra-param handlers. NEW file.
Aliases query + mutation state, normalizeAliases, getAliasValidationError, dirty tracking, reset-on-model. NEW file.
updateModel mutation + updateModelAliases orchestration with partial-failure toasts. NEW file.
General tab leaf component + extracted ReasoningSection using CollapsibleSection. NEW file.
Routing tab wrapping existing ModelAliasesEditor. NEW file.
Advanced tab: API Base, Provider, Costs, Extra Params. NEW file.
REWRITE as thin composer exposing ModelConfigController.
REWRITE as Tabs shell + sticky footer; consumes ModelConfigController.
Minimal update to consume the new controller shape; verify typecheck/test/lint.

tasks.title: Extract useModelConfigSave hook
tasks.description: Create a save-orchestration hook that takes the model, form state, and alias state and performs the same save sequence as today: update model route + config first, then update aliases, with full partial-failure handling.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/web/src/features/models/hooks/use-model-config-save.ts is created and exports useModelConfigSave
The hook receives model, formData, aliasesState, queryClient, and onSaved callbacks
It builds the same ModelRouteUpdate payload as current use-model-config-page.ts, including cost parsing and extra-params conversion
It validates non-negative numeric input/output costs and surfaces toast errors
It calls updateModel(...) then updateModelAliases(...) in sequence when aliases are loaded
It preserves all current partial-failure toasts and invalidation behavior
It exposes saving boolean and save(): Promise<void>
rules: Use the same updateModel mutation shape as today (updateModel(modelName, modelRoute, undefined, config))
Use updateModelAliases from @/shared/lib/api-client/model-aliases
Do not call queryClient.invalidateQueries inside the form hook or aliases hook; save hook owns invalidation
Do not start implementation on main without user consent

steps.title: Create the hook file and define its interface
steps.description: Create apps/web/src/features/models/hooks/use-model-config-save.ts. Define UseModelConfigSaveArgs and UseModelConfigSaveResult. Args: model, formData (ModelConfigFormData from A1), aliasesState (UseModelAliasesResult from A2), queryClient, onSaved(). Result: saving boolean, save(): Promise<void>.
steps.expectedResult: File compiles and imports the two new hooks

steps.title: Copy route-update payload construction
steps.description: Use resolveModelRoute(model) as base, strip displayName/family/ownedBy/apiMode/vision, then set upstreamBaseUrl, providerName, enabled, inputCostPerToken, outputCostPerToken, and requestOptions from formData. Parse inputCostPerToken/outputCostPerToken as numbers. Validate non-negative finite values and toast on error. Convert extraParams entries to parsed requestOptions via parseExtraParamValue from models-form-utils, deleting empty keys.
steps.expectedResult: Payload matches current handleSave payload construction exactly

steps.title: Implement the save sequence and partial-failure handling
steps.description: 1) Validate aliases using aliasesState.getValidationError() only when aliasesState.loaded. 2) Call updateModel mutation with route + config from buildConfigFromFormData. 3) If aliases not loaded, invalidate queries and toast the same warning as today. 4) If aliases loaded, call updateModelAliases with aliasesState.normalizedAliases, invalidate queries, then call onSaved(). 5) Catch alias mutation errors, invalidate queries, and toast the same error message. 6) Catch general errors with toast.
steps.expectedResult: All success, warning, and error toast messages match current behavior

steps.description: Run the web typecheck to verify the new save hook compiles against A1 and A2.
steps.expectedResult: Exit code 0
